name: Pine bark extract
short: A systematic review of 15 small trials (791 participants) could draw no definitive conclusions about safety. No interaction data were found.
text: A systematic review of 15 randomised trials (791 participants) of a French maritime pine bark extract in seven chronic disorders could draw no definitive conclusions about its safety, because the trials were small, few per condition, varied in the outcomes measured and at risk of bias. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.

citations.label: Schoonees et al., 2012, Cochrane Database Syst Rev
citations.title: Pycnogenol® (extract of French maritime pine bark) for the treatment of chronic disorders.
